explanation.definitionFit: Sterne's gentle, obsessive Uncle Toby has long been seen as an English counterpart of Cervantes's deluded knight.

clue.text: Henry, a Scandinavian philosophical politician

explanation.definitionFit: Viscount Haldane, War Secretary and Lord Chancellor, published philosophical work, notably The Pathway to Reality.

clue.text: One proverbially strong kind of tie or collar

explanation.definitionFit: An oxbow is the bent piece of wood forming the collar of a yoke for draught cattle.

clue.text: Horrendous Dick, criminal chiseller who pursues a princess

clue.text: Winter novel with a November murder victim

clue.text: Indian Ocean traveller's off to the east of south Pakistan

clue.text: Hardy character who loves Somerset

clue.text: Carbonates forming a source of oil

clue.text: Nun and priest are captured by Zulu

taken as written

clue.text: Upper part of building (flat) ticks boxes

clue.text: A number are partial to greens

clue.text: Top hero is perversely bourgeois and genteel

clue.text: Some cake's allowed to follow fish

clue.text: Dreadful nauseating art that apparently inspired Oscar Wilde
